dimensions.assessment: Directly impacts federal agencies participating in technical standards and eligible entities or organizations hosting standards meetings for emerging technologies.
dimensions.evidence: awarding grants to eligible entities described in subsection (b) hosting meetings of organizations... to support the hosting of such meetings in the United States.

dimensions.assessment: Creates administrative reporting mechanisms, a web portal for guidance, and a limited pilot grant program covering up to half of meeting costs.
dimensions.evidence: not more than fifty percent of anticipated cost of hosting the meeting and not more than a maximum amount

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes grant awards for hosting meetings subject to the availability of appropriated funds, without specifying total program budget caps.
dimensions.evidence: subject to the availability of appropriated funds, the Director shall... establish a pilot program on supporting standards meetings

dimensions.assessment: Amends existing statutory language on international standards development, institutes mandatory federal interagency reporting, creates a web portal, and establishes a pilot grant program.
dimensions.evidence: The Director shall establish an accessible web portal to help such industry and agencies navigate and participate in such efforts.

dimensions.assessment: Establishes a pilot grant program that terminates five years after enactment, alongside ongoing reporting requirements and potential permanent recommendations.
dimensions.evidence: The pilot program required by subsection (a)(1) shall terminate on the date that is 5 years after the date of the enactment of this Act.

missing_information: Specific funding amounts or overall budget caps for the pilot grant program and web portal creation.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill directs NIST and the Department State to perform briefings, establish a web portal, and run a 5-year pilot grant program supporting standards meetings in the United States, representing moderate administrative and programmatic changes.

latest_action.text: Ordered to be Reported in the Nature of a Substitute (Amended) by Voice Vote.
